name: The Crooked
tagline: A former criminal who knows every angle. You have contacts, tricks and enemies from the old life, and you now use all of it against monsters.
luckSpecial: Spending a Luck point means a figure from your old life shows up again, before long.

moves.intro: Besides the basic moves, you take two Crooked moves, both chosen from the list. Your background (below) adds one more small trick.

choices.name: Artifact
choices.summary: You keep a magic item you took for yourself. Choose one: a protective amulet (1-armour, magic, recharges); a lucky charm (counts once as a Luck point, then it is gone); a grimoire (reading up in it earns +1 forward on a use magic roll); a skeleton key (opens any lock sealed by magic); or an imp stone (a minor demon serves the holder, summoned through the use magic move).

choices.name: Crew
choices.summary: Three or four trusted people work with you and will help on nearly any job. Treat them as a team (rulebook page 119).

choices.name: Deal with the Devil
choices.summary: Your soul belongs to the Devil. Choose one or two perks: wealth, fame, youth, sensual gratification, or skill (+1 to two ratings). The bill comes due when you die, or sooner: after six months if you took two perks, after a year if you took one.

choices.name: Friends on the Force
choices.summary: Some police officers will bend the rules for you if you make it worth their while. Act under pressure to contact them whenever you need the law pointed elsewhere. It will cost you something, though maybe not immediately.

choices.name: Made
choices.summary: You belong to a gang. Name it and decide how what it does connects to your past. Members will back you up if you pay them. The bosses will sometimes give you tasks, with pay. Small mistakes get forgiven, but never cross another made member.

choices.name: Driver
choices.summary: While you are behind the wheel you have +1 ongoing. You can start any vehicle without keys; the older the vehicle, the less gear you need. You own two practical, easy-to-find vehicles, such as a sportscar and a van.

choices.name: Home Ground
choices.summary: Back in your old part of town, locals remember that your crew looked after them. There you can always find someone who will shelter you or do a small favour, with no questions.

choices.name: Notorious
choices.summary: Your criminal past made you feared. If you tell someone who you are, that fearsome name is a good enough reason for them to comply when you use manipulate someone. Naming yourself may cause trouble down the line.

extras.title: Background
extras.intro: Before hunting monsters you made a living outside the law. Choose one past job; each comes with its own skill.

options.label: Hoodlum
options.detail: When you manipulate someone by threatening violence, you may roll +Tough rather than +Charm.

options.label: Burglar
options.detail: Roll +Sharp when you break into a secured place. On a 10+ choose three of these, on a 7-9 choose two: nobody sees you go in; nobody sees you leave; no mess is left behind; you locate the thing you came for.

options.label: Grifter
options.detail: Before you manipulate someone, you may put this question to the Keeper: what would persuade them to do as I ask? The answer must be truthful, though it can be partial.

options.label: Fixer
options.detail: Roll +Charm to buy, sell or hire something. 10+: you know exactly who would be interested. 7-9: only one person can do it, but there is a catch; choose one: you owe them, they once burned you, or you once burned them. Miss: the one person able to help is someone who despises you.

options.label: Assassin
options.detail: The first attack you make against a target that is not expecting it does +2 harm.

options.label: Charlatan
options.detail: Roll +Cool to make people think you are working real magic. 10+: the crowd is fully taken in. 7-9: you made a few slips and somebody might spot it. You can also read fortunes to manipulate people, and then you get a free question on what they currently hope for, even when you miss.

options.label: Pickpocket
options.detail: Roll +Charm to lift something small. 10+: you take it and the target never notices. 7-9: choose one problem: you fail to take it, you take the wrong item, or the target recalls you afterwards.

extras.title: Heat
extras.intro: Your past has left you with enemies. Choose two or more, and decide who each person is.

options.label: A police detective
options.detail: A police detective (give a name) is determined to see you locked up.

options.label: A rival from your background
options.detail: A rival from your old life (give a name) takes every chance to ruin things for you.

options.label: A well-connected criminal
options.detail: A criminal with strong connections (give a name) is angry at you and wants you ruined by any means.

options.label: Someone with special powers
options.detail: Someone with special powers (name them), either a person or a monster, whom you took advantage of.

options.label: An old partner you betrayed
options.detail: A former partner (give a name) whom you double-crossed during a job.

extras.title: Underworld
extras.intro: Pick how you discovered the real underworld. Keep it in mind when choosing your moves so everything fits together.

options.label: The target of a job was a dangerous creature
options.detail: Choose one creature type: vampire, werewolf, troll or reptiloid.

options.label: You worked with someone who was more than they seemed
options.detail: Choose what they were: a sorcerer, a demon, a faerie or a psychic.

options.label: You were hired by something weird
options.detail: Choose what hired you: an immortal, a god, an outsider or a witch.

options.label: Things went south on a job
options.detail: Other mishaps are possible too, but choose one of these as the cause: a salamander, a dream-eater, a hunger of ghouls, or a horde of goblins.

history: They know what you did as a criminal. Tell them which of your crimes they witnessed.
They were present the day you quit crime to chase monsters. Decide together how it went.
They are your kid brother or sister, or your child (possibly adopted), and you watch over them.
They are a cousin or other more distant relative.
They rescued you when a monster had you cornered, so you owe them a favour.
You and they pulled a job that was partly or fully illegal. Decide together what the job was.
They are your conscience: after you discuss a decision with them, you tend to do the decent thing.
You are strongly drawn to them, and hope one day to be good enough for them.

improvements.text: Gain an ally: one of your old crew
Recover a stash of money from the old days, enough to live without care for a year or two
Take a move from another playbook
